Abstract.AbstractText: DEAD-box family protein is a kind of ATP dependent RNA helicase, which plays a critical role in RNA metabolism. The DEAD-box family proteins can affect cell proliferation, differentiation, and apoptosis through regulating the expression of oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes and tumor related signaling pathways. It plays the role in promoting or suppressing cancer.
